confluences.title: Confluences
confluences.description: Each Confluence merges its subscription sources into Profiles, with its own template, sync schedule and VLAN links.
confluences.loadError: Could not load Confluences. Try refreshing.
confluences.deleteHint: Delete {{name}} with its sources and Profiles? This cannot be undone.
confluences.creator: Creator

confluence.cronHint: Supports Unix-style cron expressions with an hourly minimum interval, for example
confluence.profileScriptHint: The script receives ProfileTransformContext and returns the modified ClashMetaConfig; ctx.request contains headers, url, and body.

profileAge.title: age encryption recipients
profileAge.hint: Use all selected supplicants by default. Their shared subscription includes only VLANs and tunnels each can access. An empty selection serves plaintext without VLAN tunnels.
profileAge.unsafeHint: Returns plaintext when the request selects one supplicant and sends their matching private key in User-Agent. Use HTTPS. Client and proxy logs can expose the key.

confluence.qrcodeAlt: QR code for the profile URL

profileTransformPreview.headersObjectOnly: Request headers must be a JSON object.
profileTransformPreview.hint: Renders the saved profile on the server exactly as the subscription endpoint would, including VLAN injection and age encryption. Edit the request, then Refresh.

syncError.refreshFailed: A subscription source failed to refresh. Use the error details button on its card.
syncError.truncatedBody: Only the first 64 KiB of the response body is shown.

cron.hourlyMinimum: Only Unix-style cron expressions with an hourly minimum interval are supported.

vlans.title: VLAN

cidr.hint: Press Enter, space or comma to add. Paste several at once; click an entry to edit it.
cidr.invalid: "{{token}}" is not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR.

vlans.name: Name

wireGuardImport.title: Import WireGuard configuration
wireGuardImport.clientHint: Paste the WireGuard client configuration this tunnel will share with its authorized supplicants.
wireGuardImport.reviewClient: Client draft updated. Verify that the VLAN CIDRs cover all peer AllowedIPs.
wireGuardImport.format: Use one [Interface] followed by one or more [Peer] sections.
wireGuardImport.endpoint: Enter a valid endpoint with a hostname or IP address and a port from 1 to 65535.
wireGuardImport.allowedIps: Enter a comma-separated list of valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDRs.
wireGuardImport.keepalive: Mihomo requires the same PersistentKeepalive setting across all peers.
wireGuardImport.fields: Check the keys and addresses. Supported fields are Address, PrivateKey, MTU, Endpoint, PublicKey, PresharedKey, AllowedIPs and PersistentKeepalive.

vlans.saveError: Could not save VLAN settings. Check tunnel credentials, grants and whether the VLAN CIDRs cover every AllowedIPs entry.
vlans.hint: Restrict a Profile subscription with vlans=office,lab&supplicants=alice,bob in the URL or in the confluence/ User-Agent marker.
vlans.loadError: Could not load the VLAN catalog.
vlans.deleteNetworkHint: Deleting this VLAN also removes its references from every Confluence.
vlans.removeMemberHint: Removing {{name}} also revokes their {{count}} tunnel grant(s).
vlans.enabledHint: Inactive VLANs keep their settings but are left out of subscriptions.
vlans.membersHint: Supplicants allowed to join this VLAN. Grant them access to individual tunnels below.
vlans.tunnelsHint: Each tunnel has one WireGuard client configuration shared by the VLAN members granted access.
vlans.removeTunnelHint: Delete this tunnel, its grants and its stored credentials?
vlans.accessEmpty: Add VLAN members above to grant them access here.
vlans.peersEmpty: No peers yet. Import a client config or add one manually.
vlans.wireGuardDescription: Configure or import a WireGuard client, then select which VLAN members can use it.
vlans.routesHint: Traffic to these CIDRs is routed into the VLAN. They must cover every tunnel's AllowedIPs.

blockers.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
blockers.incompleteWireGuard: Every WireGuard configuration needs an address and at least one peer.
blockers.enabledIncomplete: An active VLAN needs at least one tunnel and one CIDR.

vlans.pageDescription: Manage shared VLANs and their tunnels. Link VLANs from a Confluence page.

supplicants.title: Supplicants

supplicants.name: Supplicant key
supplicants.loadError: Could not load supplicants. Try refreshing.
supplicants.saveError: Could not save the supplicant. Check its name and age public key.
supplicants.deleteError: Could not delete the supplicant. Refresh and check its Profile and VLAN references.
supplicants.inUse: Remove this supplicant from its Profiles and VLANs before deleting it.
supplicants.recipientHint: age X25519 public key (age1…), e.g. from age-keygen -y.
